propositions: Tool-call loops in the agentic verify step exhaust the step budget and surface bare LLMError with diagnostic: null instead of a verdict.
The existing repetition-detection metric is inverted on real traces and cannot distinguish k-cycles from healthy breadth.
Emptying the advertised tool surface mid-run after tool calls have occurred triggers a Bedrock/Anthropic 400 error (toolConfig must be defined while history holds toolUse blocks).
Step-budget exhaustions are not caught and routed to bounded recovery, blocking verdict construction from fresh evidence.
Request and tool-call usage is not recorded durably by default, preventing tuning the gate from production data.
A runaway detector signal (windowed distinct-ratio with window 24 and trip threshold ≤0.50) routed to bounded recovery will abort looping runs and deliver verdicts built from per-criterion evidence.
